notes: A national occupational standard and competency-based curriculum, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.
Stores the 14 competency units only; the curriculum modules and learning hours are not stored and no overall course duration is stated.

The NYSC course title is Motorcycle Mechanic; in this standard 'Motorcycle Mechanic' is the NVQ Level 03 package and 'Motorcycle Technician' the NVQ Level 04 package. Both packaging passages are stored.

The source is internally inconsistent: the packaging on page 8 awards NVQ Level 04 without U10 (U10 earns a record of achievement), while the endorsement page lists U10 in G50S006Q4L4. Both statements are shown as published; neither is resolved here.
The unit list numbers the basic units 14-17 after unit 10, as published.
Covers motorcycles only; it does not name three-wheelers.
scope_verbatim: National Certificate at NVQ Level 03 in the occupation of Motorcycle Mechanic will be awarded to those who are competent in U01+ U02+ U03+ U04+ U05+ U07+ BU01+ BU02+ BU03+ BU04 G50S006Q3L3

National Certificate at NVQ Level 04 in the occupation of Motorcycle Technician will be awarded to those who are competent in U01+ U02+ U03+ U04+ U05+ U06+ U07+ U08+ U09 + BU01+ BU02+ BU03+ BU04– G50S006Q4L4
Record of achievement (ROA) will be awarded to those who are competent in G50S006U10 unit
